chapter: Cage on musicians, travels and old songs
title: Fiddlers and guitarists heard at Newport
summary: Cage says few fiddlers were at Newport, one from Connecticut, and a good white guitarist.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans

blocks.x: North of the city, I went to Newport. They had plenty of them up there. Mm-mm. They had one from Canada. Canada, Connecticut, whatever they call that place. Connecticut. Yes. You know his name? No, sir. I don't know his name.
Yes. And what about, uh, let's see, uh, guitar players? Did you hear any good guitar players? Yeah, I saw on the stage. What? Uh-huh.
There was not many violin players.
But a few, some guitar players. Yeah.
That white fella that played, he'd jump them.

Yeah, but I ain't talking about him. That's another time. Oh, this man hasn't been. He called you the Mexican or something. Mm-hmm. And he could play good. He was a good guy. He's about the best man. And he had plenty of songs.
